snippet.title: Inteligência Comunicativa
snippet.description:
Nem toda conversa difícil é estragada pelo que foi dito. Muitas são estragadas pelo que a gente supõe que o outro quis dizer.

Em A Fazenda, Thaíde deu um toque em Serginho na frente de todo mundo, em tom de conselho.

Pode ter sido só um conselho. Pode ter sido uma crítica bem embrulhada. Não dá pra saber.

O que chama atenção é a resposta de Serginho. Ele não se defende nem pede explicação. Agradece, chama o Thaíde de mestre, abaixa o corpo em reverência e pede desculpas.

Ele respondeu ao que foi dito, não a uma intenção que ninguém consegue provar. E essa resposta funciona nos dois cenários: se era conselho, ele recebeu bem; se era alfinetada, não sobrou nada pra brigar.

Isso não significa engolir tudo. Quando vira padrão, cabe colocar limite. Mas, diante de uma fala isolada, a pergunta mais útil talvez seja: o que essa pessoa disse? E tem alguma coisa aqui que me serve?

Você costuma responder ao que foi dito ou ao que você acha que a pessoa quis dizer?

#AFazenda #Serginho #Thaíde #oratória #comunicação

El líder del PP se dirigió a la candidata de Frente Amplio con un «y usted, calladita» durante el intercambio sobre la gestión de la DANA y la responsabilidad política por lo ocurrido en Paiporta.

Pedro Sánchez reprochó inmediatamente sus palabras, mientras Colau respondió durante el debate y volvió a denunciar el comportamiento del candidato popular a su salida. Feijóo defendió posteriormente el sentido de su comentario y reiteró sus críticas a los partidos de Frente Amplio. También se pronunciaron representantes del PSOE, PP, Vox y Frente Amplio. Recopilamos todas las reacciones políticas a una de las escenas más comentadas del debate electoral del 29N.

Hello everyone, I am Kay, a sculptor from China. I started learning polymer clay under the guidance of my father when I was a child. I have passed down this craft for nearly twenty years. In November 2021, I started recording my craftsmanship and uploading it to YouTube as a video. With a phone, a computer, and a desk, I completed my first goal in life alone in less than two years, channel Successfully surpassed 1 million subscribers. Next, I hope many, many friends can contact me here to jointly pass on the ancient craft of clay sculpture. I will slowly gather friends who love sculpture to form my team to better serve every friend who likes and loves me. This is my goal for the next stage, thank you all!

TRIBUN-VIDEO.COM - Massa mendatangi rumah yang diduga ditempati keluarga salah satu remaja dalam kasus pengeroyokan Silva Nur Intania Putri (17), pada Jumat (27/11/2026) malam.

Rumah tersebut berada di Perumahan Emerald Garden, Desa Saptorenggo, Kecamatan Pakis, Kabupaten Malang.

Massa mulai berdatangan sekitar pukul 21.00 WIB. Puluhan personel kepolisian telah disiagakan untuk mengamankan kawasan perumahan.

Jumlah massa terus bertambah hingga menjelang tengah malam. Situasi kemudian memanas dan terjadi bentrokan dengan aparat kepolisian.

Dalam kericuhan tersebut, terdengar ledakan petasan dan terjadi aksi lempar batu. Dua mobil patroli Polsek Pakis dilaporkan dibakar setelah sebagian massa masuk ke kompleks perumahan.

Aksi warga juga berlangsung di sekitar kawasan Polresta Malang Kota dan SMAN 7 Malang, sekolah tempat Silva menuntut ilmu.

Sebelumnya, Polresta Malang Kota menetapkan empat remaja sebagai anak yang berhadapan dengan hukum dalam kasus dugaan pengeroyokan Silva. Polisi menyatakan proses hukum tetap berjalan dengan memperhatikan hak-hak anak. (Tribun-video.com / lulu)

snippet.title: They don't want you to add it up..
snippet.description:
The night the FAA grounded every plane, people all over the country were outside pointing their phones at the sky.

November 13th. They told us it was a router, a software patch, a contractor at one location. Nothing was supposed to be up there that night. And yet a hunter in West Virginia, a light streaking south over Texas and Mexico, and people in state after state filmed the most that night.

So why is the official count so small? The National UFO Reporting Center has been taking reports since 1974. In August of this year, they logged their 200,000th report. From January to late August, they had about 1,880 reports — for the whole country, in almost eight months. California leads with over 17,000. Then Florida, almost 9,000. Then Washington State.

But that's only the people who reported. Most of you didn't know there was a place to file one. I see orbs over my house almost every night. I've never filed one report. So that number isn't how many people are seeing things. It's how many people know where to send it. The real number has to be many times bigger, and nobody is counting it.

Meanwhile the Pentagon has been putting its UFO files out in batches since May — a few at a time, mostly on Fridays, never with an answer attached. And the sightings keep piling up: a sphere in daylight over El Paso, next to Fort Bliss. Something over Texas that just stopped moving in midair. A sphere sitting over Titusville, right across the water from Cape Canaveral. Red orbs over San Diego. Orbs over Denver International Airport at sunrise. Five ovals filmed from a plane window over Da Nang, Vietnam, at 30,000 feet.

What if the low number is the point? If nobody knows where to report, nobody can add it up. And if nobody adds it up, nobody has to answer for it.
